headline: Names a New York City post office building at 450 Lexington Avenue after Vincent R. Sombrotto.
what_it_does: This law officially renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 450 Lexington Avenue in New York City as the "Vincent R. Sombrotto Post Office." It is an honorary naming measure. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was enacted on August 8, 2014.
